Class ModelTypes

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.model.ModelTypes
public final class ModelTypes extends Object
The data models as the store holds them after import: each model with its name, version, and url, each class with its model and its base, so that a type name met in a library resolves to the class concept and a class concept writes back as the name a library uses.
